blocks.text: The French naturalist Jean-Baptiste Lamarck (1744 - 1829) was an early proponent of the idea that evolution. In 1809, he published a book ‘Philosophie Zooloqique’ (Zoological Philosophy). In this book, he presented the idea of progression (change) known as Lamarckism.

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: The title of Lamarck’s book is printed ‘Philosophie Zooloqique’; it is ‘Philosophie Zoologique’.
